english: Congratulations! You have met the goals of your merchant marine and built for them enough ships and docks to empower their plans. Please choose a reward from among the benefits your new trading empire is able to provide to you.
chinese: 恭喜！你已达成商船队的目标，为他们建造了足够的船只与船坞，助其实现宏图。请从你的新兴贸易帝国所能提供的诸多益处中选择一项奖励。

english: You have failed the quest of the Harbormaster
chinese: 你未能完成港务长的任务

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must construct %d1 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Harbors[COLOR_REVERT] in your various coastal cities. You will also have to build %d2 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Caravels[COLOR_REVERT].[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization completes it first, or if you reach the Industrial Era without having met the conditions.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须在各沿海城市中建造 %d1 座[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]港口[COLOR_REVERT]。你还需要建造 %d2 艘[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]卡拉维尔帆船[COLOR_REVERT]。[PARAGRAPH:1]若敌对文明抢先完成，或你进入工业时代仍未满足条件，则此任务失败。

english: Use our advantage to boost the seamanship of our current and future Naval units
chinese: 利用我们的优势，提升现有及未来海军单位的航海本领

english: Our trade empire should be leveraged in to producing lots of wealth.
chinese: 应善用我们的贸易帝国来创造大量财富。

english: Our ship captains gain extra experience, enabling them to better navigate.
chinese: 我们的船长将获得额外经验，从而更善于航行。

english: Our eldest scholars have collaborated on an effort to collect, record, and preserve all of our oral traditions and unwritten literature.[PARAGRAPH:1]They require storage space for pottery, stone tablets and other artifacts, as well as special repositories within our cities.
chinese: 我们最年长的学者们通力合作，致力于收集、记录并保存我们所有的口传传统与未成文的文学。[PARAGRAPH:1]他们需要存放陶器、石板及其他文物的空间，以及城中专门的典藏库。

english: %s1_civ scholars have successfully recorded all of their oral traditions and stories in to a new compendium of literature, thereby completing the quest of Classic Literature!
chinese: %s1_civ 的学者们已成功将他们所有的口传传统与故事记录进一部新的文学总集，从而完成了古典文学任务！

english: Congratulations! You have met the goals of your scholars and built for them enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Libraries[COLOR_REVERT] to store their newly recorded works. Please choose a reward from among the benefits your new treasure trove of written literature are able to provide to you.
chinese: 恭喜！你已达成学者们的目标，为他们建造了足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]图书馆[COLOR_REVERT]来收藏其新近记录的著作。请从你新积累的文学宝藏所能提供的诸多益处中选择一项奖励。

english: Classic Literature[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by our scholars to build enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Libraries[COLOR_REVERT] to hold the newly recorded texts of our ancient stories and oral traditions.
chinese: 古典文学[PARAGRAPH:1]学者们委托你建造足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]图书馆[COLOR_REVERT]，以收藏我们古老故事与口传传统的新记录文本。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must build %d1 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Libraries[COLOR_REVERT] in your various cities.[PARAGRAPH:1]An additional reward option will be available if you control the [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Great Library[COLOR_REVERT] if and when this quest is successfully completed.[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization completes it first, or if you reach the Renaissance Era without having met the conditions.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须在各城市中建造 %d1 座[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]图书馆[COLOR_REVERT]。[PARAGRAPH:1]若此任务成功完成时你控制着[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]大图书馆[COLOR_REVERT]，将获得一项额外奖励选项。[PARAGRAPH:1]若敌对文明抢先完成，或你进入文艺复兴时代仍未满足条件，则此任务失败。

english: You have failed the quest of Classic Literature.
chinese: 你未能完成古典文学任务。

english: Our library with the largest repository of classic literature receives a research bonus.
chinese: 藏有最多古典文学的图书馆获得研究加成。

english: Discover and decipher lost knowledge from within some of the literature.
chinese: 从部分文学中发掘并破译失落的知识。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Receive a random Technology from among Ancient Era techs not yet discovered.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]获得一项尚未研究的远古时代科技（随机）。

english: [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]The Great Library[COLOR_REVERT] receives additional scholars to help boost research.
chinese: [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]大图书馆[COLOR_REVERT]获得额外学者，助力提升研究。

english: The master blacksmith in %s2_city has offered to take on and train multiple apprentices if the government will build new forges for them to operate once their training has been completed.[PARAGRAPH:1]We will need to build enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Forges[COLOR_REVERT] in our cities to accommodate the master's new students.
chinese: %s2_city 的铁匠大师提出，只要政府在学徒们完成训练后为其建造新的锻造坊供其营作，他便愿意招收并培养多名学徒。[PARAGRAPH:1]我们需要在城市中建造足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]锻造坊[COLOR_REVERT]，以容纳这位大师的新学生。

english: The Master Blacksmith[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by the master blacksmith to build enough new [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Forges[COLOR_REVERT] to provide acceptable working environments for all the students to whom he intends to pass on his trade secrets.
chinese: 铁匠大师[PARAGRAPH:1]铁匠大师委托你建造足够的新[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]锻造坊[COLOR_REVERT]，为他打算传授技艺秘诀的所有学生提供合适的工作环境。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must build a total of %d1 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Forges[COLOR_REVERT] in your various cities. This may include Forges already completed.[PARAGRAPH:1]The master smith is a religious man. An additional reward option will be available if your civilization has a state religion if and when the quest is completed successfully.[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization completes it first, if you lose control over %s2_city and the master smith, or if you reach the Renaissance Era without having met the conditions.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须在各城市中建造共 %d1 座[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]锻造坊[COLOR_REVERT]，已建成的锻造坊可计入其中。[PARAGRAPH:1]这位铁匠大师是个虔诚之人。若任务成功完成时你的文明拥有国教，将获得一项额外奖励选项。[PARAGRAPH:1]若敌对文明抢先完成，或你失去对 %s2_city 及这位铁匠大师的控制，或你进入文艺复兴时代仍未满足条件，则此任务失败。

english: Congratulations! You have met the goals of your master blacksmith and built enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Forges[COLOR_REVERT] for each for his students to have his own to operate. Please choose a reward from among the benefits your new metalworking empire is able to provide to you.
chinese: 恭喜！你已达成铁匠大师的目标，为他每一位学生建造了足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]锻造坊[COLOR_REVERT]，使其各有一座可供营作。请从你新兴的金属工艺帝国所能提供的诸多益处中选择一项奖励。

english: The skilled %s1_civ_adjective metalworkers have completed the quest of The Master Blacksmith!
chinese: 技艺精湛的 %s1_civ_adjective 金属工匠们已完成铁匠大师任务！

english: You have failed the quest of The Master Blacksmith.
chinese: 你未能完成铁匠大师任务。

english: Use our advantage to discover a new source of [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Copper[COLOR_REVERT].
chinese: 利用我们的优势，发现一处新的[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]铜[COLOR_REVERT]矿资源。

english: Our metalworking empire should be leveraged into producing stronger weaponry.
chinese: 应善用我们的金属工艺帝国来打造更强的武器。

english: The master's best student will be granted control over his forge when he retires, launching a tradition of metalcasting excellence in that city.
chinese: 大师退休时，他最优秀的学生将获得其锻造坊的掌控权，在那座城市开创一段金属铸造的卓越传统。

english: Our generals request government aid in expanding our fortifications.[PARAGRAPH:1]We will need to build enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Castles[COLOR_REVERT] to satisfy their views on mounting a proper defense for our nation.
chinese: 我们的将军们请求政府协助扩建防御工事。[PARAGRAPH:1]我们需要建造足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]城堡[COLOR_REVERT]，以满足他们对为国家部署妥善防御的主张。

english: The Best Defense[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your armed forces to build enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Castles[COLOR_REVERT] for them to ward off invasion effectively.
chinese: 最佳防御[PARAGRAPH:1]你的军队委托你建造足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]城堡[COLOR_REVERT]，以有效抵御入侵。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must build %d1 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Castles[COLOR_REVERT] in your cities.[PARAGRAPH:1]An additional reward option will be available if your civilization controls the Great Wall.[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization completes it first, or if you discover [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Rifling[COLOR_REVERT], [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Railroad[COLOR_REVERT], or [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Economics[COLOR_REVERT] without having met the conditions.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须在城市中建造 %d1 座[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]城堡[COLOR_REVERT]。[PARAGRAPH:1]若你的文明控制着长城，将获得一项额外奖励选项。[PARAGRAPH:1]若敌对文明抢先完成，或你在未满足条件的情况下研究出[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]来复枪[COLOR_REVERT]、[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]铁路[COLOR_REVERT]或[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]经济学[COLOR_REVERT]，则此任务失败。

english: The sturdy %s1_civ_adjective people have completed The Best Defense quest!
chinese: 坚毅的 %s1_civ_adjective 人民已完成最佳防御任务！

english: Congratulations! You have met the goals of your military planners and built enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Castles[COLOR_REVERT] to serve as fortresses against invaders. Please choose a reward from among the benefits your defense is able to provide to you.
chinese: 恭喜！你已达成军事策划者的目标，建造了足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]城堡[COLOR_REVERT]，作为抵御入侵者的要塞。请从你的防御所能提供的诸多益处中选择一项奖励。

english: You have failed the quest of The Best Defense
chinese: 你未能完成最佳防御任务

english: Use our advantage to help better train our forces.
chinese: 利用我们的优势，更好地训练我们的军队。

english: Leverage our defensive advantage in to political capital.
chinese: 将我们的防御优势转化为政治资本。

english: Now that we are safe, focus on learning what others are planning.
chinese: 如今我们已然安全，专注于探知他人的图谋。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Receive [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]%D1[COLOR_REVERT] attitude from all leaders
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]获得所有领袖 [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]%D1[COLOR_REVERT] 的态度提升

english: Our cultural advisors believe that our nation could benefit from city-based sports franchises if we built enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Colosseums[COLOR_REVERT] to support national sports leagues.[PARAGRAPH:1]Each major city would require its own facility in which its teams could play.
chinese: 我们的文化顾问认为，若我们建造足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]竞技场[COLOR_REVERT]以支撑全国性体育联赛，各城市的体育俱乐部能让国家受益。[PARAGRAPH:1]每座大城市都需要有自己的场馆供其队伍比赛。

english: National Sports League[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your cultural advisors to build enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Colosseums[COLOR_REVERT] to support viable sports leagues.
chinese: 全国体育联赛[PARAGRAPH:1]你的文化顾问委托你建造足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]竞技场[COLOR_REVERT]，以支撑可行的体育联赛。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must build %d1 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Colosseums[COLOR_REVERT] in your cities.[PARAGRAPH:1]An additional reward option will be available if you control [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s2_building[COLOR_REVERT] if and when this quest is successfully completed.[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization completes it first, or if you reach the Modern Era without having met the conditions.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须在城市中建造 %d1 座[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]竞技场[COLOR_REVERT]。[PARAGRAPH:1]若此任务成功完成时你控制着[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s2_building[COLOR_REVERT]，将获得一项额外奖励选项。[PARAGRAPH:1]若敌对文明抢先完成，或你进入现代仍未满足条件，则此任务失败。

english: The %s1_civ_adjective cities have built enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Colosseums[COLOR_REVERT] to complete the National Sports League quest, strengthening their social fabric and their national identity.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的城市已建造足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]竞技场[COLOR_REVERT]，完成了全国体育联赛任务，强化了他们的社会凝聚力与民族认同感。

english: Congratulations! You have met the goals of your sports entrepreneurs and built enough [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Colosseums[COLOR_REVERT] to support viable leagues. Please choose a reward from among the benefits your new national pastimes can provide to you.
chinese: 恭喜！你已达成体育经营者的目标，建造了足够的[COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]竞技场[COLOR_REVERT]以支撑可行的联赛。请从你新兴的全民消遣所能提供的诸多益处中选择一项奖励。

english: Use the leagues to make your people happy.
chinese: 利用这些联赛让你的人民欢乐。

english: Leverage these sports leagues in to a cultural tradition.
chinese: 将这些体育联赛转化为一种文化传统。

english: Organize  large-scale periodic sporting events in the name of Zeus.
chinese: 以宙斯之名组织大规模的周期性体育赛事。

english: You have failed the quest of The National Sports League.
chinese: 你未能完成全国体育联赛任务。

english: Our war against the %s1:2_civ_adjective continues. Our spiritual leaders cry out for us to wage a crusade to wrest control of %s6_city away from them.
chinese: 我们对 %s1:2_civ_adjective 的战争仍在继续。我们的精神领袖疾呼，要我们发动一场圣战，从他们手中夺取 %s6_city 的控制权。

english: Crusade[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your religious leaders to capture and occupy the Holy City.
chinese: 圣战[PARAGRAPH:1]你的宗教领袖委托你攻占并占领这座圣城。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization captures %s1_city first, if you change your state religion, or if your war ends for any reason prior to your success.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]若敌对文明抢先占领 %s1_city，或你更改国教，或你的战争在你成功之前因任何缘由结束，则此任务失败。

english: Congratulations! Your Crusade to secure the sacred lands of %s2_city has wrested control of the city away from the %s1:2_civ_adjective! Please choose a reward from among the benefits that may accrue from the joy your people feel in this successful Crusade.
chinese: 恭喜！你为夺取 %s2_city 圣地而发动的圣战，已从 %s1:2_civ_adjective 手中夺得了这座城市的控制权！请从你的人民因这场胜利的圣战而生的喜悦所可能带来的诸多益处中选择一项奖励。

english: %s1_civ_adjective armies have completed their Crusade, wresting control of the Holy City of %s2_city away from the %s4_civ_adjective people!
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的军队已完成他们的圣战，从 %s4_civ_adjective 人民手中夺得了圣城 %s2_city 的控制权！

english: Your Crusade has ended. The quest has failed.
chinese: 你的圣战已经结束。任务失败。

english: The Holy City needs more protection. Recruit and train capable units from among the faithful.
chinese: 圣城需要更多保护。从信徒中招募并训练能干的单位。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Add %d1 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s2_unit[COLOR_REVERT] [NUM1:defender:defenders] to %s3_city.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]在 %s3_city 增加 %d1 个 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s2_unit[COLOR_REVERT] [NUM1:defender:defenders]。

english: Harness the fervor of the believers to construct a Holy Shrine to honor the sacred sites where our faith was born.
chinese: 驾驭信徒的热忱，建造一座圣祠，以敬奉我们信仰诞生的圣地。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Build [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s1_building[COLOR_REVERT] in %s2_city.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]在 %s2_city 建造 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s1_building[COLOR_REVERT]。

english: Spread the word of our success and of the blessings of our faith as far and wide as possible.
chinese: 尽可能广泛地传扬我们的胜利与信仰的福音。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Spread [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]%s1_religion[COLOR_REVERT] to up to %d2 new [NUM2:city:cities].
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]将 [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]%s1_religion[COLOR_REVERT] 传播至多 %d2 座新的 [NUM2:city:cities]。

english: A miracle performed at the city wall in %s2_city is attracting %s3_religion_adjective pilgrims from far and wide.
chinese: %s2_city 城墙处显现的一场奇迹，正吸引着四面八方的 %s3_religion_adjective 朝圣者。

english: A miracle is believed to have occurred at the city wall in %s2_city. Pilgrims are flocking from all over to visit the new holy site.
chinese: 据信 %s2_city 的城墙处发生了一场奇迹。朝圣者正从各地涌来，探访这处新的圣地。

english: The tourism will enhance city revenue.
chinese: 这股旅游热潮将增加城市收入。

english: We should hire and train some of the pilgrims as missionaries.
chinese: 我们应招募并训练部分朝圣者，使其成为传教士。

english: A renowned playwright from %s2_city is attracting patrons and fans from far and wide.
chinese: %s2_city 一位声名远扬的剧作家正吸引着四面八方的赞助人与拥趸。

english: A prolific playwright from %s2_city has written a long series of exceptionally popular plays. His home theatre has gained renown.
chinese: %s2_city 一位多产的剧作家写下了一长串异常受欢迎的剧作。他的家乡剧院因而声名鹊起。

english: The theatre patronage will enhance city revenue.
chinese: 剧院的赞助将增加城市收入。

english: We could double the cultural value of the theatre by officially sanctioning this artist's works.
chinese: 我们可以通过正式认可这位艺术家的作品，使剧院的文化价值翻倍。

english: A %s1_civ_adjective gladiator from %s2_city has become a local hero and an inspiration.
chinese: %s2_city 一位 %s1_civ_adjective 角斗士已成为当地英雄与人们的激励。

english: A gladiator from %s2_city has survived many battles in the arena. He is attracting a lot of fans.
chinese: %s2_city 一位角斗士在竞技场中历经无数搏斗而幸存。他正吸引着大批拥趸。

english: No one survives forever. Cash in on the phenomenon before he meets the inevitable end.
chinese: 没人能永远幸存。趁他迎来必然的结局之前，利用这一热潮牟利。

english: Arrange for him to be matched against easy opponents and see that his legend increases.
chinese: 安排他对阵较弱的对手，让他的传奇声名更盛。

english: A cache of ancient texts has been discovered hidden away in a %s1_civ_adjective monastery.
chinese: 在一座 %s1_civ_adjective 的修道院里，发现了一批隐藏起来的远古典籍。

english: A cache of ancient writings has been discovered hidden away in a cubby hole in a monastery in %s2_city!
chinese: 在 %s2_city 一座修道院的暗格里，发现了一批隐藏起来的远古文献！

english: Hand the material over to our researchers.
chinese: 将这些材料交给我们的研究者。

english: Preserve these works as a cultural treasure.
chinese: 将这些著作作为文化珍宝加以保存。

english: A warlord from %s2_city has made a generous contribution to his community.
chinese: %s2_city 一位军阀为其社区慷慨解囊。

english: An esteemed warlord who operates from the castle in %s2_city has offered to set up a special military academy at his own expense.
chinese: 一位在 %s2_city 城堡中活动的受人敬重的军阀，提出自费设立一所特殊的军事学院。

english: We have no need of his services. Ask him instead to donate his money to the state.
chinese: 我们无需他的效劳。改而请他把钱捐给国家。

english: Excellent! Have him train Pikeman units for us.
chinese: 太好了！让他为我们训练长枪兵单位。

english: Superb! Have all our military recruits in that city undergo a training regimen at the new academy.
chinese: 妙极！让那座城市所有的新兵都在这所新学院接受一套训练课程。

english: Vermin got in to the granary in %s2_city. All the food stored there was ruined.
chinese: 害虫钻进了 %s2_city 的粮仓。储存在那里的所有粮食都被毁了。

english: Vermin have gotten in to the granary in %s2_city. All the food stored there is spoiled.
chinese: 害虫钻进了 %s2_city 的粮仓。储存在那里的所有粮食都已变质。

english: That sounds like bad news, but what can we do? Nothing.
chinese: 听起来是个坏消息，可我们又能怎么办？无能为力。

english: Pay to have the lost grain replaced.
chinese: 出钱补上损失的粮食。

english: The hospital in %s2_city is gaining favor among the pious because it is believed to be blessed by a spirit angel.

english: You have failed the quest of the Warships!
chinese: 你未能完成战舰任务！

english: Our generals request that we focus on making guns. These are the weapons of the future! [PARAGRAPH:1]If we train enough [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Musketman[COLOR_REVERT] units, we should be able to command any battlefield.
chinese: 我们的将军们请求专注于制造枪械。这些是未来的武器！[PARAGRAPH:1]若我们训练足够的[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]火枪兵[COLOR_REVERT]单位，我们应能掌控任何战场。

english: Guns Not Butter[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your military leaders to train a sizable force of musket units.
chinese: 要枪不要黄油[PARAGRAPH:1]你的军事领袖委托你训练一支规模可观的火枪单位部队。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must train %d1 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT] Musketman[COLOR_REVERT] units.[PARAGRAPH:1]An additional reward option will be available if your civilization is operating in the [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Vassalage[COLOR_REVERT] civic.[PARAGRAPH:1]An additional reward option will be available if your civilization controls [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s2_building[COLOR_REVERT].[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization completes it first, or if you discover advanced firearms ([COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Rifling[COLOR_REVERT] or [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Railroad[COLOR_REVERT] technologies) without having met the conditions.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须训练 %d1 个[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT] 火枪兵[COLOR_REVERT]单位。[PARAGRAPH:1]若你的文明正采用[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]附庸制[COLOR_REVERT]政体，将获得一项额外奖励选项。[PARAGRAPH:1]若你的文明控制着 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s2_building[COLOR_REVERT]，将获得一项额外奖励选项。[PARAGRAPH:1]若敌对文明抢先完成，或你在未满足条件的情况下研究出先进火器（[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]来复枪[COLOR_REVERT]或[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]铁路[COLOR_REVERT]科技），则此任务失败。

english: Congratulations! You have trained a large enough force of musket units. Please choose your reward.
chinese: 恭喜！你已训练出一支规模足够庞大的火枪单位部队。请选择你的奖励。

english: With such a large force of musketmen working together, additional training for these units can be achieved.
chinese: 有了如此庞大的火枪兵部队协同作战，便可为这些单位进行额外训练。

english: Leverage our military advantage to collect harsh taxes from our feudal lords and their counties.
chinese: 利用我们的军事优势，向我们的封建领主及其领地征收严苛的赋税。

english: Enjoy our Golden Age of Muskets.
chinese: 尽享我们的火枪黄金时代。

english: The %s1_civ_adjective people have trained the largest force of musket units. Advisors across the known world are panicking at the thought of their nation being ground under the thundering clatter and deadly terror of an endless hail of bullets.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 人民已训练出规模最庞大的火枪单位部队。举世皆知的顾问们一想到本国将被那震耳的枪声与无尽弹雨的致命恐怖碾于其下，无不惊慌失措。

english: You have failed the quest of "Guns not Butter!"
chinese: 你未能完成“要枪不要黄油”任务！

english: Our civilization cries out for nobility to lead our people forward into a brighter future. [PARAGRAPH:1]If we train enough [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Knights[COLOR_REVERT], we should be able to find our way forward, through times peaceful or warlike.
chinese: 我们的文明疾呼，需要贵族引领我们的人民迈向更光明的未来。[PARAGRAPH:1]若我们训练足够的[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]骑士[COLOR_REVERT]，无论时局和平还是战乱，我们都应能找到前进之路。

english: Noble Knights[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by the mandate of your people to train a sizable force of [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Knight[COLOR_REVERT] units.
chinese: 高贵骑士[PARAGRAPH:1]受人民的托付，你的使命是训练一支规模可观的[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]骑士[COLOR_REVERT]部队。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must train %d1 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Knights[COLOR_REVERT] units.[PARAGRAPH:1]An additional reward option will be available if your civilization is operating in the [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Organized Religion[COLOR_REVERT] civic.[PARAGRAPH:1]An additional reward option will be available if your civilization controls [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s2_building[COLOR_REVERT].[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization completes it first, or if you discover advanced firearms ([COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Military Tradition[COLOR_REVERT], [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Rifling[COLOR_REVERT], or [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Railroad[COLOR_REVERT] technologies) without having met the conditions.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须训练 %d1 个[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]骑士[COLOR_REVERT]单位。[PARAGRAPH:1]若你的文明正采用[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]神权统治[COLOR_REVERT]政体，将获得一项额外奖励选项。[PARAGRAPH:1]若你的文明控制着 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s2_building[COLOR_REVERT]，将获得一项额外奖励选项。[PARAGRAPH:1]若敌对文明抢先完成，或你在未满足条件的情况下研究出先进火器（[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]军事传统[COLOR_REVERT]、[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]来复枪[COLOR_REVERT]或[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]铁路[COLOR_REVERT]科技），则此任务失败。

english: Congratulations! You have trained a large enough force of [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Knight[COLOR_REVERT] units. Please choose your reward.
chinese: 恭喜！你已训练出一支规模足够庞大的[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]骑士[COLOR_REVERT]部队。请选择你的奖励。

english: With such a large force of Knights working together, additional training for these units can be achieved.
chinese: 有了如此庞大的骑士部队协同作战，便可为这些单位进行额外训练。

english: Enlist our noble Knights into a drive to spread our faith.
chinese: 招募我们高贵的骑士，投入一场传播信仰的运动。

english: From among our most faithful knights emerges one with holy vision.
chinese: 在我们最虔诚的骑士中，涌现出一位怀有神圣异象之人。

english: The %s1_civ_adjective people have trained the largest force of knights. Advisors across the known world tremble at the thought of facing rows of lances powered by the thundering hooves of a full battle charge.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 人民已训练出规模最庞大的骑士部队。举世皆知的顾问们一想到要直面由全速冲锋、隆隆马蹄所驱动的排排长矛，无不胆战心惊。

english: You have failed the quest of "Noble Knights!"
chinese: 你未能完成“高贵骑士”任务！

english: Our brightest admiral has proposed an amphibious assault strategy designed to capture port cities with lightning strikes.[PARAGRAPH:1]If we construct a large enough aircraft carrier battle fleet, we can bring any coastal city to its knees, making it much easier to attack amphibiously. We need a force large enough to disable all defenses with heavy shore bombardment and soften the defenders by bombing from the air. Then our troops may land on the same day the battle begins and thrust inland against a foe who will be in total disarray.
chinese: 我们最出色的海军上将提出了一套两栖突击战略，旨在以闪电突袭夺取港口城市。[PARAGRAPH:1]若我们打造一支规模足够庞大的航空母舰战斗舰队，便能令任何沿海城市屈膝，使其更易于遭受两栖攻击。我们需要一支规模庞大到足以用猛烈的岸轰瘫痪一切防御、并以空中轰炸削弱守军的部队。随后我们的军队可在战斗打响当日登陆，向内陆推进，直捣陷入彻底混乱的敌人。

english: The Overwhelm Doctrine[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your military leaders to construct a fully functional aircraft carrier battle fleet.
chinese: 压制战术[PARAGRAPH:1]你的军事领袖委托你打造一支完全可用的航空母舰战斗舰队。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must build %d1 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s2_unit[COLOR_REVERT], %d3 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s4_unit[COLOR_REVERT], %d5 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s6_unit[COLOR_REVERT], and %d7 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s8_unit[COLOR_REVERT] units. A source of [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Oil[COLOR_REVERT] will be required to fuel the planes.[PARAGRAPH:1]An additional reward option will be available if your civilization was the one to build [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s9_building[COLOR_REVERT].[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization completes it first.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须建造 %d1 个 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s2_unit[COLOR_REVERT]、%d3 个 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s4_unit[COLOR_REVERT]、%d5 个 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s6_unit[COLOR_REVERT] 及 %d7 个 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]%s8_unit[COLOR_REVERT] 单位。需要一处[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]石油[COLOR_REVERT]资源为飞机供给燃料。[PARAGRAPH:1]若建造 [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]%s9_building[COLOR_REVERT] 的正是你的文明，将获得一项额外奖励选项。[PARAGRAPH:1]若敌对文明抢先完成，则此任务失败。

english: Congratulations! You have built a powerful Aircraft Carrier battle fleet capable of conquering enemy cities in a single attack. A force capable of executing the Overwhelm Doctrine is now yours to command. Please choose your reward.
chinese: 恭喜！你已打造出一支强大的航空母舰战斗舰队，能够以单次攻击征服敌方城市。一支足以施行压制战术的部队如今归你调遣。请选择你的奖励。

english: Take advantage of our momentum to provide additional training for these crews. Prepare them for battle.
chinese: 趁我们的势头为这些船员进行额外训练。让他们做好战斗准备。

english: Our intent is to keep the peace through strength. Leverage our might in to commercial opportunity.
chinese: 我们意在以实力维持和平。将我们的强大转化为商业机遇。

english: Leverage our military advantage to persuade the world to ban nuclear weapons.
chinese: 利用我们的军事优势，说服世界禁绝核武器。

english: [ICON_BULLET]No nuclear weapons.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]无核武器。

english: The %s1_civ_adjective people have constructed what is by far the most deadly fleet of warships in the history of warfare. Their aircraft carrier battle group could crush anything that gets in its way.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 人民已打造出战争史上迄今最致命的战舰舰队。他们的航空母舰战斗群能够碾碎任何挡路之物。

english: You have failed the quest of the "Overwhelm Doctrine!"
chinese: 你未能完成“压制战术”任务！

english: The Chief Executive Officer of %s11_corporation seeks government incentives to better enable his company to expand.[PARAGRAPH:1]If we can assist in spreading his corporation to new cities, profits will skyrocket.
chinese: %s11_corporation 的首席执行官寻求政府激励，以便让其公司更好地扩张。[PARAGRAPH:1]若我们能协助将其企业扩展到新的城市，利润将扶摇直上。

english: Corporate Expansion[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your corporate leaders to expand the reach of their corporation.
chinese: 企业扩张[PARAGRAPH:1]你的企业领袖委托你扩大其公司的业务范围。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must spread [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]%s1_corporation[COLOR_REVERT] to %d2 new cities.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须将 [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]%s1_corporation[COLOR_REVERT] 扩展到 %d2 座新城市。

english: Congratulations! You have completed the quest of Corporate Expansion and enabled %s11_corporation to turn extra profit.
chinese: 恭喜！你已完成企业扩张任务，使 %s11_corporation 得以获取额外利润。

english: Cha-ching! Show me the money!
chinese: 钱到手啦！把钱给我看看！

english: The %s1_civ_adjective people have completed the quest of Corporate Expansion. %s6_corporation profits expected to skyrocket.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 人民已完成企业扩张任务。预计 %s6_corporation 利润将扶摇直上。

english: You have failed the quest of the Corporate Expansion!
chinese: 你未能完成企业扩张任务！

english: The Chief Executive Officer of %s11_corporation covets getting out from under the thumb of foreign suppliers of raw materials.[PARAGRAPH:1]If we can obtain control over all resource types his corporation needs for industrial use, their profits will skyrocket.
chinese: %s11_corporation 的首席执行官渴望摆脱外国原材料供应商的掌控。[PARAGRAPH:1]若我们能取得其企业工业用途所需一切资源类型的控制权，他们的利润将扶摇直上。

english: Hostile Takeover[PARAGRAPH:1]You are tasked by your corporate leaders to obtain (by any means necessary) our own source of all resource types they need to conduct their operations.
chinese: 恶意收购[PARAGRAPH:1]你的企业领袖委托你（不择手段地）获取他们开展经营所需一切资源类型的自有来源。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]To complete this quest, you must settle near uncontrolled resources or attack rival civilizations and take over their resources.[PARAGRAPH:1]You will need to obtain new sources of %d1 [NUM1:resource type:different resource types] (%s2_list_of_resources).[PARAGRAPH:1]You must also retain control over all needed resource types already owned.[PARAGRAPH:1]You will fail this quest if a rival civilization who is also seeking to obtain control over needed resources for one of its corporations should happen to complete this task ahead of you.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]要完成此任务，你必须在无主资源附近建城，或攻击敌对文明并夺取其资源。[PARAGRAPH:1]你需要获取 %d1 [NUM1:resource type:different resource types]（%s2_list_of_resources）的新来源。[PARAGRAPH:1]你还必须保有已拥有的一切所需资源类型的控制权。[PARAGRAPH:1]若另一个同样意图为其某家企业争夺所需资源控制权的敌对文明恰好抢在你之前完成此任务，则此任务失败。

english: Congratulations! You have completed the quest of Hostile Takeover and enabled %s11_corporation to turn extra profit.
chinese: 恭喜！你已完成恶意收购任务，使 %s11_corporation 得以获取额外利润。

english: Cha-ching! Show me the money!
chinese: 钱到手啦！把钱给我看看！

english: The %s1_civ_adjective people have completed the quest of Corporate Expansion. %s6_corporation profits expected to skyrocket.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 人民已完成企业扩张任务。预计 %s6_corporation 利润将扶摇直上。

english: You have failed the quest of the Hostile Takeover!
chinese: 你未能完成恶意收购任务！

english: The %s1_civ_adjective game designers have developed a new game of Civilization.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的游戏设计师们开发出了一款全新的文明游戏。

english: Our game designers have developed a new addictive game of Civilization. How shall we proceed?
chinese: 我们的游戏设计师们开发出了一款令人上瘾的全新文明游戏。我们该如何行事？

english: Send congratulations to the developers. Our people should enjoy this game.
chinese: 向开发者们致以祝贺。我们的人民应会喜欢这款游戏。

english: This game seems to have great educational potential. Suggest that it be used in our educational system.
chinese: 这款游戏似乎具有极大的教育潜力。建议将其用于我们的教育体系。

english: Computer games? They have no place in our society! Sell the franchise to foreign buyers!
chinese: 电脑游戏？它们在我们的社会里没有立足之地！把经营权卖给外国买家！

english: Sir, our slaves are on the verge of revolting! As long as our society continues to use slaves, there is a possibility of them revolting!
chinese: 大人，我们的奴隶已濒临反叛！只要我们的社会继续使用奴隶，他们就有反叛的可能！

english: The slaves of %s2_city are on the verge of revolt!
chinese: %s2_city 的奴隶已濒临反叛！

english: Inspired by books telling stories about the culture of %s2_city, immigrants are flowing to the city!
chinese: 受讲述 %s2_city 文化的书籍所激励，移民正涌向该城！

english: Immigrants are flowing to %s2_city inspired by stories of its culture!
chinese: 受其文化故事所激励，移民正涌向 %s2_city！

english: %s1_civ_adjective herbalists have discovered a plant that might result in better illness treatment.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的草药师们发现了一种或许能改善疾病治疗的植物。

english: Our herbalists have discovered a new plant that holds great promise for health treatments. However, tests on human subjects are required to find the right mixture.
chinese: 我们的草药师们发现了一种新植物，在健康疗法方面大有希望。然而，需要在人体上进行试验才能找到正确的配方。

english: Forget these tests. Anything worth knowing has already been discovered, so why risk needless death?
chinese: 别管这些试验了。值得知道的一切早已被发现，何必冒无谓的死亡风险？

english: Alright, try limited tests, but only on non-essential citizens.
chinese: 好吧，进行有限的试验，但只在非关键的市民身上进行。

english: Health is the bedrock to world domination! Run full scale tests on all but the youngest and weakest among us.
chinese: 健康是称霸世界的基石！除最年幼与最孱弱者外，对所有人进行全面试验。

english: In their attempts to find the right mixture of herbs, our healers caused fatalities throughout the empire!
chinese: 在尝试寻找正确草药配方的过程中，我们的医者在整个帝国造成了多起死亡！

english: Our experiments have been a success! Our cities now enjoy better healing herbs!
chinese: 我们的试验成功了！我们的城市如今享有更好的疗伤草药！

english: Our experiments have been a resounding success! We now posess much better treatments!
chinese: 我们的试验大获成功！我们如今拥有了好得多的疗法！

english: A great beast has been discovered near one of our hunting camps.
chinese: 在我们的一处狩猎营地附近发现了一头巨兽。

english: Let it breed and give offspring. Hunt sparingly.
chinese: 让它繁衍生息，留下后代。有节制地捕猎。

english: Looks like it could feed many people. Organize a hunting party!
chinese: 看起来它足以喂饱许多人。组织一支狩猎队！

english: Hunt it? Are you mad? The beast is a manifestation of a divine spirit!
chinese: 捕猎它？你疯了吗？这头巨兽是神圣精灵的化身！

english: [ICON_BULLET]%D1[ICON_HAPPY] in all cities with %F3_religion for %d2 [NUM2:turn:turns].
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]在所有信奉 %F3_religion 的城市中获得 %D1[ICON_HAPPY]，持续 %d2 [NUM2:turn:turns]。

english: A %s1_civ_adjective philosopher has stirred up controversy among the religious population.
chinese: 一位 %s1_civ_adjective 哲学家在信教民众中激起了争议。

english: A philosopher from %s2_city is stirring up controversy among our population. Our people are highly distrustful of his teachings.
chinese: %s2_city 一位哲学家正在我们的民众中激起争议。我们的人民对他的学说极为不信任。

english: We won't tolerate such heresy. Send him into exile!
chinese: 我们绝不容忍这等异端。将他放逐！

english: He's a senile old fool. Let him teach if he wants to.
chinese: 他不过是个昏聩的老糊涂。他若想教书便由他去吧。

english: That's one exceptional mind! Sponsor an Academy for him to teach!
chinese: 真是一位卓绝的头脑！资助一所学院供他讲学！

english: A high-ranking %s1_civ_adjective intelligence agent has defected to the %s4_civ_adjective government.
chinese: 一名 %s1_civ_adjective 高级情报特工已叛逃至 %s4_civ_adjective 政府。

english: One of our high-ranking intelligence agents has defected to the %s1_civ_adjective empire.
chinese: 我们的一名高级情报特工已叛逃至 %s1_civ_adjective 帝国。

english: That's regrettable. We'll need to review our security procedures.
chinese: 真是遗憾。我们需要重新审查我们的安全程序。

english: Unacceptable. An "accident" should happen to the traitor!
chinese: 无法接受。这个叛徒该出一场“意外”！

english: The citizens of %s2_city are worried about their safety because of the city's Jail.
chinese: %s2_city 的市民因城中的监狱而忧心自身安危。

english: People of %s2_city are not feeling safe. They are worried that criminals may escape from the local Jail.
chinese: %s2_city 的人民感到不安。他们担心罪犯可能会从当地监狱越狱。

english: So what? No one is going to escape anyway.
chinese: 那又如何？反正没人逃得出去。

english: Boost jail security and organize a campaign to convince the citizens that they're safe.
chinese: 加强监狱戒备，并组织一场运动让市民相信他们是安全的。

english: A %s4_civ_adjective infiltrator has been dicovered in the %s1_civ_adjective government.
chinese: 一名 %s4_civ_adjective 渗透者已在 %s1_civ_adjective 政府中被发现。

english: A %s1_civ_adjective spy is operating on a high level in our government! What should we do?
chinese: 一名 %s1_civ_adjective 间谍正在我们政府的高层活动！我们该怎么办？

english: Be discreet. Offer the to release the spy to their government, but question him first.
chinese: 谨慎行事。提出将这名间谍交还其政府，但先审问他一番。

english: Every man has his price. His knowledge could make him a very valuable asset.
chinese: 人人皆有其价码。他的情报可使他成为一份极有价值的资产。

english: That is an act of war! Clearly, our people and military contractors will rise to the occasion!
chinese: 这是战争行为！显然，我们的人民与军工承包商将挺身而出，共赴时艰！

english: [ICON_BULLET]Receive %d1 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT][NUM1:Tank:Tanks][COLOR_REVERT].
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]获得 %d1 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT][NUM1:Tank:Tanks][COLOR_REVERT]。

english: News reports indicate massive %s1_civ_adjective protests over the country's nuclear weapons stockpile.
chinese: 新闻报道显示，%s1_civ_adjective 民众正就本国的核武器储备大规模抗议。

english: Our people are protesting against our nuclear arsenal. They fear that we would use nukes with disastrous consequences.
chinese: 我们的人民正抗议我们的核武库。他们担心我们会动用核武，酿成灾难性后果。

english: The people's wishes are our top priority. We will disband our nuclear weapons.
chinese: 人民的意愿是我们的首要考量。我们将解除我们的核武器。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Lose all nuclear weapons.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]失去所有核武器。

english: What? Find those who spread such nonsense and prosecute them!
chinese: 什么？找出散布这等胡言乱语的人，将他们起诉！

english: We need a positive publicity campaign for our military, right now!
chinese: 我们现在就需要为军队发起一场正面宣传运动！

english: %s1_civ_adjective scientists have developed better ways of processing coal fuel.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 科学家们研发出了处理煤炭燃料的更佳方法。

english: Our scientists have developed better ways of processing coal fuel. Our economy stands ready to benefit from this development.
chinese: 我们的科学家们研发出了处理煤炭燃料的更佳方法。我们的经济已准备好从这一进展中获益。

english: Put it to use at our Coal-fueled power plants. Production is power!
chinese: 将其用于我们的燃煤发电厂。产能即是力量！

english: I suppose we can make our Drydocks a more healthy place to work and slightly more productive, then.
chinese: 那么，我想我们可以让干船坞成为更健康的工作场所，并略微提升其产能。

english: The dam in %s2_city has broken, flooding the city's suburbs and killing people.
chinese: %s2_city 的水坝已经溃决，淹没了城市郊区并造成人员死亡。

english: The dam in %s2_city has broken. The city's suburbs are flooded and deaths have been reported.
chinese: %s2_city 的水坝已经溃决。城市郊区被淹，已有死亡报告。

english: That is very unfortunate, but we can not help. Tell the local authorities they'll have to handle the situation.
chinese: 这十分不幸，但我们无能为力。告诉当地当局，他们得自行处理这一局面。

english: Repair the dam from our emergency funds.
chinese: 动用我们的应急资金修复水坝。

english: Repair the dam and provide compensation to the affected families.
chinese: 修复水坝，并向受灾家庭提供补偿。

english: A Rabbi from %s2_city has written a valuable collection of religious works.
chinese: %s2_city 一位拉比写下了一部珍贵的宗教著作集。

english: A Rabbi from %s2_city has written a collection of religious works that is of great importance to Judaism worldwide.
chinese: %s2_city 一位拉比写下了一部宗教著作集，对全世界的犹太教都意义重大。

english: These works should be distributed to cities in our empire and abroad.
chinese: 这些著作应分发到我们帝国境内及海外的各城市。

english: The Rabbi certainly deserves state funding for his endeavours.
chinese: 这位拉比的努力当然值得国家资助。

english: Works like these can easily make the local Monastery a site of interests to tourists worldwide.
chinese: 此类著作能轻易使当地的修道院成为全世界游客的兴趣所在。

english: A blacksmith from %s2_city has made a beautiful golden Buddha statue at his Forge.
chinese: %s2_city 一位铁匠在其锻造坊里做出了一尊精美的黄金佛像。

english: A blacksmith working in the Forge of %s2_city has made a beautiful golden statue of Buddha.
chinese: 一位在 %s2_city 锻造坊中工作的铁匠做出了一尊精美的黄金佛像。

english: That's not his job. Sell the statue and remind the blacksmith what his responsibilities are.
chinese: 那不是他的本职。把塑像卖了，并提醒这铁匠他的职责所在。

english: Impressive. This should make the Forge a cultural attraction.
chinese: 令人赞叹。这应能使锻造坊成为一处文化景点。

english: The blacksmith is a true talent, we should encourage him to make more of these statues.
chinese: 这铁匠是个真正的天才，我们应鼓励他多做些这样的塑像。

english: A well-known scientist from %s2_city has become a preacher at the local Christian Monastery.
chinese: %s2_city 一位知名科学家已成为当地基督教修道院的一名传道人。

english: A scientist from %s2_city has undergone baptism and become a preacher at the city's Christian Monastery.
chinese: %s2_city 一位科学家已受洗，成为该城基督教修道院的一名传道人。

english: Send the scientist our well wishes.
chinese: 向这位科学家致以我们的美好祝愿。

english: See if the scientist would be willing to continue the scientific work at the Monastery, given some additional funding.
chinese: 看看这位科学家是否愿意在获得一些额外资助的情况下，于修道院继续其科研工作。

english: The man who is Tezcatlipoca's likeness has escaped during this year's Toxcatl feast in the %s1_civ_adjective Empire.
chinese: 在 %s1_civ_adjective 帝国今年的托斯卡特尔节庆上，那位作为特斯卡特利波卡化身之人逃脱了。

english: During the Toxcatl feast, the young man who is Tezcatlipoca's likeness has escaped from the teokalli in %s2_city before he could be sacrificed!
chinese: 在托斯卡特尔节庆期间，那位作为特斯卡特利波卡化身的年轻人，在被献祭之前从 %s2_city 的神庙中逃脱了！

english: This is horrible news. May the heavens be merciful...
chinese: 这是可怕的消息。愿上苍垂怜……

english: Make every effort to recapture him!
chinese: 竭尽全力将他重新抓获！

english: A priest from %s2_city is doubting the supreme power of Amun-Re.
chinese: %s2_city 一位祭司正质疑阿蒙-拉的至高权能。

english: A dissident priest from %s2_city is doubting the supreme power of Amun-Re in an unprecedented outbreak of heresy.
chinese: %s2_city 一位持异见的祭司正质疑阿蒙-拉的至高权能，酿成一场前所未有的异端爆发。

english: That is disgusting and preposterous. The heresy must be dealt with in the name of Amun-Re, even if the locals won't support it.
chinese: 这既恶心又荒谬。必须以阿蒙-拉之名处置这异端，哪怕当地人不予支持。

english: We can ignore that nutter, our people will get over it.
chinese: 我们可以无视那个疯子，我们的人民会渐渐淡忘的。

english: Diversity is good. Allow these beliefs to spread and be recorded, though convincing our people that it's nothing to fear won't be easy.
chinese: 多元是好事。允许这些信念传播并被记录下来，尽管说服我们的人民相信它并不可怕并非易事。

english: Industrious villagers have built a Pasture in %s1_civ_adjective lands.
chinese: 勤劳的村民们在 %s1_civ_adjective 的土地上建起了一座牧场。

english: Industrious villagers near our city of %s2_city have built a Pasture.
chinese: 我们 %s2_city 城附近勤劳的村民们建起了一座牧场。

english: Send them our thanks.
chinese: 向他们致以我们的谢意。

english: A rogue radio station in the %s1_civ_adjective city of %s2_city is broadcasting propaganda against the ruling party.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 城市 %s2_city 的一家非法电台正播送反对执政党的宣传。

english: A rogue radio station in %s2_city is broadcasting propaganda against our ruling party in an amazing display of impudence.
chinese: %s2_city 的一家非法电台正以惊人的厚颜无耻播送反对我们执政党的宣传。

english: Send a blackops group to destroy the radio tower, we can blame it on an industrial accident.
chinese: 派一支黑色行动小组摧毁那座电台塔，我们可以把它归咎于一场工业事故。

english: Round up the broadcasters, that should send a message.
chinese: 把那些广播员统统抓起来，这样便能传递一个讯息。

english: Wait for the station to get more listeners, then round them up along with the broadcasters and send them all to do labour at our factories.
chinese: 等电台招揽到更多听众，再把他们连同广播员一并抓起来，全部送去我们的工厂做苦役。

english: %s1_civ_adjective antimonarchists are protesting, saying that the religious institutions don't have enough power compared to the King.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 的反君主主义者正在抗议，声称宗教机构相较于国王权力不足。

english: Anti-monarchists are claiming that the King has too much power and that religious leaders need to have some, too.
chinese: 反君主主义者声称国王权力过大，宗教领袖也需要分得一些权力。

english: Our King is the State!
chinese: 朕即国家！

english: It's a valid point, our clerics need more influence.
chinese: 这话在理，我们的教士需要更多影响力。

english: The %s1_civ_adjective President is facing impeachment.
chinese: %s1_civ_adjective 总统正面临弹劾。

english: The Congress wants to impeach the President. The population supports this motion.
chinese: 国会想要弹劾总统。民众支持这项动议。

english: Then the impeachment should proceed, if that's the people's will.
chinese: 那么，若这是人民的意愿，弹劾便该进行下去。

english: That's an overreaction. The President has gotten the message that his administration needs to improve.
chinese: 这是反应过度了。总统已经明白，他的政府需要改进。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Persuade other nations to convert to [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Environmentalism[COLOR_REVERT] (at least one civilization must have the ability to do so).
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]说服其他国家转向[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]环境保护主义[COLOR_REVERT]（至少须有一个文明有能力这样做）。

english: Saltpeter Discovered.
chinese: 发现了硝石。

english: All records of ancient games have been forever lost.
chinese: 古代竞技会的一切记录已永远失传。

english: You may keep your gods and rituals, your codes and your honor. Why should I care for obscure promises of afterlife rewards and the merits of virtue, when I've got a whole cellar full of pure, liquid bliss encased in glass and wood?-Dengrahl Lern, Merchant
chinese: 你尽可留着你的诸神与仪典、你的律条与荣誉。当我坐拥满窖封存于玻璃与木桶之中、纯净如液的至福时，我又何必去在意那些关于来世赏赐的晦涩许诺，以及德行的种种好处？——商人邓格拉尔·勒恩

english: The Azer are the eyes of Bhall in Erebus. She has sent them into creation to learn what has changed while she slept during the Age of Ice.
chinese: 阿扎尔是巴尔在埃瑞布斯的眼睛。她将他们派入造物，去探知她在冰之纪元沉睡期间发生了何等变迁。

english: A Beast of Agares is a living beast that has gone through an unholy ritual that strengthens it. The ritual involves massive human sacrifice. Beasts of Agares enjoy hunting paladins, and can sense the presence of one from miles away.
chinese: 邪神妖兽是一头活生生的野兽，经历了一场使其强化的邪恶仪式。该仪式牵涉大规模的活人献祭。邪神妖兽以猎杀圣骑士为乐，并能在数英里之外感知到圣骑士的存在。

english: In later generations of the Age of Rebirth, most armies would deploy detachments of brutal men fueled by bloodlust called berserkers. Battle rage makes their surroundings disappear as they tear away their opposition armed with a pair of hand axes. These elite units are inspired by legends from the Age of Ice, legends of men who carried an axe in each hand.
chinese: 在重生纪元的后世，大多数军队都会部署一支支被嗜血欲驱使的凶残之徒，唤作狂战士。战斗的狂怒令他们眼中周遭尽皆消隐，他们手持一对手斧，撕碎当面之敌。这些精锐单位取灵感于冰之纪元的传说——那些双手各执一斧的男子的传说。

english: Of the beasts formed by men only the centaurs retain some part of their noble nature. Many creatures were made from the bodies of men, but they were of ten reduced to the passions of their bestial form.  Perhaps it is because the animal they were made from, the majestic stallions of the Cerici, were known for their docile nature as well as their strength. But do not assume that the Centaurs are passive. Those creeping into their glades expecting gentle pacifists bounding away like deer when they see strangers will be surprised by the firm, battle-hardened giants they find.  Centaurs are fond of war paint and other body art, thick, dangerous weapons, and feasts of wild fruit and meat so undercooked it drips with blood.
chinese: 在由人所造的野兽中，唯有半人马尚存几分其高贵的天性。许多生物是以人的躯体造就的，但他们往往堕入其兽形的种种情欲。这或许是因为造就他们所用的动物——瑟里奇那威严的骏马——既以力量著称，也以温顺闻名。但切莫以为半人马便是被动之辈。那些潜入其林间空地、指望见到温柔的和平主义者如鹿般见了生人便蹦跳逃开的人，会惊讶地发现自己面对的是坚毅、久经沙场的巨人。半人马钟爱战纹与其他人体艺术、粗重而危险的武器，以及野果与生肉几近淌血的盛宴。

english: I am the firmament upon which creation was laid. What sword can harm me? What wall can resist my strength?-Granik, earth elemental
chinese: 我便是造物赖以奠基的苍穹大地。何剑能伤我？何墙能挡我之力？——地元素格拉尼克

english: A mix of eagles and lions, griffons make loyal mounts and pets to those who are able to tame them. They enjoy dangerous flying so less reckless riders will probably only ride a griffon once.
chinese: 狮鹫混合了鹰与狮的特征，对于能够驯服它们的人而言，它们是忠诚的坐骑与宠物。它们喜好惊险的飞行，故而不够胆大的骑手多半只会骑乘狮鹫一次。

english: These demons, also called "Drinkers", consume the souls of their victims becoming more powerful each time they kill someone. After a few kills the ira becomes so powerful opponents are better served to hide until they return to normal rather than try to kill it. Calming spells are very effective against ira, and weaken them considerably.
chinese: 这些恶魔又被称作“吞噬者”，它们吞食受害者的灵魂，每杀一人便愈发强大。杀戮数次之后，恶魔艾尔会变得极为强大，与其试图杀死它，对手不如藏匿起来待其恢复常态。安抚类法术对恶魔艾尔十分有效，能大幅削弱它们。

english: Lions with wings and tails that can fire iron spikes larger than a crossbow bolt. A full grown manticore stands nearly seven feet at the shoulder. Manticores have a voracious appetite and there are few whocan afford to feed them when they are kept as guards. Likewise they are likely to overhunt their territory when living in the wild and are unable to settle in one area.
chinese: 蝎尾狮是长着双翼与尾巴的狮子，其尾能射出比弩箭更大的铁刺。一头成年蝎尾狮肩高近七英尺。蝎尾狮食量惊人，将其当作守卫豢养时，鲜有人负担得起喂养它们。同样，野生的蝎尾狮往往会将领地内的猎物捕尽，无法在一处安居。

english: A minotaur is a tall humanoid with the head of a bull. They are vigilant guardians, and outside of being unable to resist a fight they mind they are reliable soldiers.
chinese: 牛头人是长着公牛头颅的高大类人生物。他们是警觉的守卫，除了无法抗拒争斗之外，他们是可靠的士兵。

english: Once human, the mobius witches live in the bizarre between worlds of Ceridwen. In Erebus they have an odd fascination with edges, corners and doorways,sometimes to the point of fearing them. Though they display little interest in relationships with humans or with each other they are as insightful to the nature of relationships as they are obtuse about the physical world. Mobius witches are powerful spell casters, occasionally using magic unfamiliar to Erebus.
chinese: 莫比乌斯女巫曾为人类，如今栖居于瑟丽德雯诸世界之间的诡异之境。在埃瑞布斯，她们对边缘、角落与门道怀有一种古怪的痴迷，有时甚至到了畏惧它们的地步。尽管她们对与人类或彼此之间的关系鲜有兴趣，她们洞悉关系本质的敏锐，恰如她们对物质世界的迟钝。莫比乌斯女巫是强大的施法者，偶尔会使用埃瑞布斯所不熟悉的魔法。

english: Esus gifted the Svartalfar, the winter court side of the elven civil war, with a breed of large panthers that were strong mounts as well as powerful attackers in their own right. A nyxkin is a Svartalfar warrior who is bound to one of these panthers. The bond is so great that if either side dies, the other will as well.
chinese: 杰斯赐予斯瓦塔尔法——精灵内战中的寒冬宫廷一方——一种大型黑豹，它们既是强健的坐骑，本身也是强大的攻击者。豹骑兵是与其中一头黑豹缔结契约的斯瓦塔尔法战士。这契约如此深厚，一方若死，另一方亦随之而亡。

english: Ogres are huge, averaging about nine feet and occasionally as large as twelve feet tall. They are unusual in that their coloration varies dramatically between individual ogres covering every end of the spectrum. Some are hairless and some are completely covered in a thick coat of fur.
chinese: 食人巨魔身形庞大，平均约九英尺高，偶尔可达十二英尺。他们的一个奇特之处在于，不同个体之间的肤色差异极大，横跨光谱的每一端。有些通体无毛，有些则被浓密的皮毛完全覆盖。

english: Pit Beasts are tormented souls usually trapped in the chasm prisons of Camulos's hell. They are strong and mindless outside of basic animalistic urges. They have become so acclimated by pain that not only do they not fear it, but they are driven by a desire to feel it and inflict it on others.
chinese: 嗜血兽是备受折磨的灵魂，通常被囚于卡姆洛斯地狱的深渊牢狱之中。它们力大无穷，除基本的兽性冲动外全无心智。它们已被痛苦驯化到这般地步：不仅毫不畏惧痛苦，反而被一种渴求所驱使，想要感受痛苦、并将其施加于他人。

english: Skeletons are formed by binding souls into the skeletal remains of a creature. Most of the time it's a human skeleton, but animals or magical beasts can also be used. Skeletons have few thoughts beyond wanting to end life and they will attack anyone they come into contact with. Necromancers have to use magic to give them an aura of the undead to keep their skeletons from attacking them. Occasionally a skeleton will become obsessed with some fragment of his former life. A skeleton may carry a teddy bear, guard the ruins of a house, or wander behind a flock of sheep.
chinese: 骷髅是通过将灵魂束缚进生物的骸骨残骸而造就的。多数情况下是人类的骸骨，但动物或魔法野兽的骸骨也可使用。骷髅除了想要终结生命之外几无思绪，会攻击一切与之接触之人。死灵法师必须以魔法赋予自身一种不死气息，以防其骷髅攻击自己。偶尔会有一具骷髅执迷于其前世的某个片段。一具骷髅或许会抱着一只玩具熊、守护一栋房屋的废墟，或跟在一群绵羊身后游荡。

english: Sometimes when an extremely corrupt and vile person dies the ground will not accept them.  Heaven and even the afterworld are closed to them; their destiny is to have their souls dragged into hell by demons. But occasionally the demons will leave them in creation. Bitter and dark, these souls turn into spectres. Eventually demons will come for them, but until then the soul has time to haunt the world.
chinese: 有时，当一个极度腐败邪恶之人死去，大地不肯接纳他。天堂乃至冥界都对他们紧闭；他们的命运是被恶魔将灵魂拖入地狱。但恶魔偶尔会将他们留在造物之中。这些灵魂满怀怨恨与阴暗，化作幽鬼。恶魔终会来索取他们，但在那之前，这灵魂尚有时日游荡人间。

english: The stygian guards are the silent servants of Hastur.  They exhibit no attempts at communication and little evidence of thought outside of their ability to ruthlessly follow commands. When they aren't being commanded they seek out pools or other bodies of water and sink unmoving to the bottom unless disturbed.
chinese: 冥河守卫是哈斯图尔沉默的仆从。他们不曾表现出任何交流的意图，除了能冷酷无情地执行命令之外，也几乎没有思维的迹象。当他们不受命令驱使时，便会寻找水潭或其他水体，一动不动地沉入水底，除非受到扰动。

english: Hello there. Uh... I wondered if... could you spare this for us... please?
chinese: 你好啊。呃……我在想，是否……能否请你把这个匀给我们……拜托了？

english: You... I do not wish to see you here, mortal. I hope you have something serious to discuss, otherwise your usefulness as a bargaining partner will soon be surpassed by the merits of your bodily nectar.
chinese: 你……我可不愿在此见到你，凡人。我希望你有正经事要谈，否则你作为谈判对手的用处，很快便要被你体内琼浆的价值所盖过了。

english: Ahh! Why do you keep pestering me?! How am I to get any research done at this rate, can you tell me that? No? Then I propose you tell me why you've chosen to disturb me once again. I hope for your sake that it is important... very important.
chinese: 啊！你为何总来烦扰我？！照这样下去我还怎么做研究，你倒是说说看？说不出来？那我建议你告诉我，你为何又一次选择来打扰我。为你自己着想，我希望这事很重要……非常重要。

english: Hmm... it seems a shadow is cast in this room, blocking out the sun. I wonder what it will take for it to go away.
chinese: 嗯……这屋里似乎投下了一道阴影，遮蔽了阳光。我在想，要怎样它才会散去。

english: The Overcouncil is founded when the Empyrean is founded. After that any good or neutral player that has researched the Honor tech can join it.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Being a member of the Overcouncil grants a significant diplomacy bonus with other members. It also forces members to comply with any resolutions that the Overcouncil has voted and agreed on, unless the player wants to defy and leave the Overcouncil. Overall these resolutions can be powerful and restrictive. Players that expect to remain members of the Overcouncil should expect to enjoy the advantages of the friendships it allows, but also be subject to its control. That is unless they maintain the relationships required to be voted the head of the council and get to pick the decrees themselves.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Each member of the Overcouncil has one vote on resolutions. Both the Empyrean hero Chalid Astrakein and the Malakim hero Teutorix grant the players that control them an additional vote on the Overcouncil.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The Overcouncil can vote on the following resolutions:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Head Councilor: The head councilor selects all other resolutions[NEWLINE][TAB]Force War: Force war on a non-member[NEWLINE][TAB]Assign City: Return control of a city to a member[NEWLINE][TAB]Single Currency: +1 Trade Route in all cities[NEWLINE][TAB]Open Markets: Trade Routes with all foreign cities[NEWLINE][TAB]Global Civic Liberty: All members must adopt the Liberty civic[NEWLINE][TAB]Defensive Pact with all members: All members enter into a defensive pact[NEWLINE][TAB]Outlaw Death mana: No members can use Death mana[NEWLINE][TAB]Outlaw Entropy mana: No members can use Entropy mana[NEWLINE][TAB]Outlaw Shadow mana: No members can use Shadow mana
chinese: 至高议会在天空的教诲被创立时成立。此后，任何研究了荣誉科技的善良或中立玩家均可加入。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]身为至高议会成员，可获得与其他成员之间的显著外交加成。它也迫使成员遵从至高议会投票通过并议定的任何决议，除非该玩家愿意公然违抗并退出至高议会。总体而言，这些决议可能既强大又具约束力。期望留在至高议会的玩家，应期待享有它所带来的友谊之利，但也须受其掌控。除非他们维系住足以被推选为议会之首、从而得以亲自挑选法令所需的种种关系。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]至高议会每位成员在决议上各有一票。天空的教诲英雄卡利德·阿斯特拉肯与马拉基姆英雄图托里克斯，均为掌控他们的玩家在至高议会中额外授予一票。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]至高议会可就以下决议投票：[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]首席议员：由首席议员选定所有其他决议[NEWLINE][TAB]强制开战：强制向非成员开战[NEWLINE][TAB]划归城市：将一座城市的控制权归还给某位成员[NEWLINE][TAB]单一货币：所有城市 +1 贸易路线[NEWLINE][TAB]开放市场：与所有外国城市建立贸易路线[NEWLINE][TAB]全球自由政体：所有成员必须采用自由主义政体[NEWLINE][TAB]全体成员防御条约：所有成员缔结防御条约[NEWLINE][TAB]禁用死亡能量：任何成员均不得使用死亡能量[NEWLINE][TAB]禁用衰退能量：任何成员均不得使用衰退能量[NEWLINE][TAB]禁用阴影能量：任何成员均不得使用阴影能量

english: [H1]Alignment[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]There are three alignments in Fall from Heaven, Good, Neutral and Evil. Each leader starts with one and some units and civics can only be used by players of a specific alignment. It also affects your diplomatic relations with other players, granting you bonuses to players of the same alignment and negatives to players of other alignments.[PARAGRAPH:2]The only way to change your alignment is by adopting a State Religion. The Order makes any player who adopts it good, the Empyrean and the Runes of Kilmorph make evil players neutral, the Council of Esus and the Undertow make good players neutral and the Ashen Veil makes the player evil.
chinese: [H1]阵营[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]《天堂陨落》中有三种阵营：善、中立与恶。每位领袖开局时属于其中之一，某些单位与政体只能由特定阵营的玩家使用。它还会影响你与其他玩家的外交关系，令你与同阵营玩家获得加成，与不同阵营玩家产生负面影响。[PARAGRAPH:2]改变阵营的唯一途径是采用国教。绝对秩序使任何采用它的玩家变善，天空的教诲与基鲁莫夫之痕使恶方玩家变中立，杰斯议会与暗涌使善方玩家变中立，混沌之灰烬使玩家变恶。

english: [H1]Somnium[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Somnium allows you to pick any AI leader you have contact, and aren't at war with, and challenge them to a game of cards. If you win the game you get a positive attitude bonus with that leader, if you lose you get a negative attitude penalty.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Rules[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]There are 10 suits with 5 cards numbered 3-7 in each. The suits are Angels, Demons, Dragons, Swords, Cups, Pentagrams, Towers, Wands, Suns and Moons. There are also 3 Fool cards and 1 Death card. [PARAGRAPH:1]The player starts his turn by drawing a card. He can draw again or stop and collect all the cards he has turned up into his "bank". The player can continue drawing as long as he wants but his turn is ended and all of his turned up cards are discarded if he ever gets 2 cards of the same suit turned up at once. Play continues back and forth between players until all 54 cards in the deck have been drawn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Example of Play:[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]The player starts by turning over the 3 of Moons. He decides to draw again and draws the 6 of Wands. He decides to draw again and draws the 4 of Towers. He decides to draw again and draws the 4 of Wands. That last 4 is a duplicate, that is 2 cards of wands and all 4 cards he drew are lost and his turn is ended. If he would have stopped drawing after the 4 of Towers he would have been able to bank all 3 cards he drawn to that point and his turn would have been over.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Special Cards:[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]The Fool- There are three Fool cards in the deck. They allow the player to steal a card form his opponents bank and add it to the drawn card pile. If your opponent has no cards in his bank the Fool is discarded. [PARAGRAPH:1]Death- Drawing the death card automatically ends your turn and causes you to lose all your cards. There is only one death card in the deck.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Victory:[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]In the end each player gets points for the highest card in his bank he has of each suit (so if he has the 3, 4 and 5 of Moons he only counts the 5) and the player with the most points wins.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Strategy:[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]The game is about risk and deciding if you should go for that next card or not. There will be easy choices (obviously turning up a 3 of moons doesn't mean much if you already have the 5 of moons banked), and difficult ones (if your first card is the 7 of Suns should you risk it and try to get another, or just consider yourself lucky and end there). Each AI player has a different level of aggressiveness in the game, some will play conservatively, some will be more reckless.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Credits:[\\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Programmer: Stéphane "Sto" Nadry[NEWLINE]Game Designer: Derek "Kael" Paxton[NEWLINE]Art: Stephanie Pui-Mun Law and Jason Engle
chinese: [H1]梦境[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]梦境让你可以挑选任何一位你已接触、且未与之交战的 AI 领袖，向其发起一场纸牌对局。若你赢得对局，便与该领袖获得一份正面态度加成；若你输了，则获得一份负面态度惩罚。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]规则[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]共有 10 种花色，每种含 5 张牌，编号 3 至 7。这些花色是：天使、恶魔、巨龙、剑、杯、五芒星、塔、法杖、太阳与月亮。此外还有 3 张愚者牌与 1 张死神牌。[PARAGRAPH:1]玩家以抽一张牌开始自己的回合。他可以再抽，或停下并将已翻开的所有牌收入自己的“牌库”。玩家可随意继续抽牌，但一旦同时翻开 2 张同花色的牌，他的回合便告结束，所有已翻开的牌全部弃掉。玩家间来回轮流，直到牌堆中全部 54 张牌被抽完。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]对局示例：[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]玩家先翻开月亮 3。他决定再抽，抽到法杖 6。他决定再抽，抽到塔 4。他决定再抽，抽到法杖 4。最后这张 4 是重复的，凑成了 2 张法杖，他抽到的 4 张牌全部作废，回合结束。倘若他在塔 4 之后停止抽牌，本可将抽到的全部 3 张牌收入牌库，回合便随之结束。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]特殊牌：[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]愚者——牌堆中有三张愚者牌。它们允许玩家从对手的牌库中偷取一张牌，加入已翻开的牌堆。若你的对手牌库中没有牌，愚者牌便被弃掉。[PARAGRAPH:1]死神——抽到死神牌会自动结束你的回合，并使你失去所有牌。牌堆中只有一张死神牌。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]胜利：[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]最终，每位玩家就其牌库中每种花色的最高牌计分（故若他有月亮的 3、4、5，只计 5），得分最高者获胜。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]策略：[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]这局游戏关乎冒险，以及决定是否要去博下一张牌。既有轻松的抉择（显然，若你已把月亮 5 收入牌库，再翻出月亮 3 便意义不大），也有艰难的抉择（若你的第一张牌是太阳 7，你该冒险再抽一张，还是就此收手、庆幸走运）。每位 AI 玩家在游戏中的进取程度各不相同，有的保守，有的更为鲁莽。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]制作人员：[\\H1][NEWLINE][NEWLINE]程序：Stéphane “Sto” Nadry[NEWLINE]游戏设计：Derek “Kael” Paxton[NEWLINE]美术：Stephanie Pui-Mun Law 与 Jason Engle

english: [H1]Unique Features[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Unique Features are randomly generated when the map is created. There can only be one of each on each map and the chance that each will appear is based on the map size. The potential Unique Features are:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_AIFON_ISLE]Maenalus[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradeline's Well[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BROKEN_SEPULCHER]Broken Sepulcher[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_DRAGON_BONES]Dragon Bones[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GUARDIAN]Guardian of Pristin Pass[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_LETUM_FRIGUS]Letum Frigus[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MAELSTROM]Maelstrom[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MIRROR_OF_HEAVEN]Mirror of Heaven[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ODIOS_PRISON]Odio's Prison[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_POOL_OF_TEARS]Pool of Tears[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PYRE_OF_THE_SERAPHIC]Pyre of the Seraphic[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_REMNANTS_OF_PATRIA]Remnants of Patria[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SEVEN_PINES]Seven Pines[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOMB_OF_SUCELLUS]Tomb of Sucellus[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_YGGDRASIL]Yggdrasil[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]Kael's Notes: Unique Features were added to make each map more interesting. Plus some of the wonders we have had in the mod since the beginning (like Yggdrasil and the Tomb of Sucellus) never really made much sense as buildable wonders, better to be things the player would find.
chinese: [H1]独特地貌[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]独特地貌在地图生成时随机产生。每张地图上每种至多只有一个，各自出现的几率取决于地图大小。可能出现的独特地貌有：[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_AIFON_ISLE]阿尔丰岛[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]布里德兰之井[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BROKEN_SEPULCHER]邪灵坟场[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_DRAGON_BONES]巨龙埋骨地[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_GUARDIAN]普力斯提努司关口的守护神[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_LETUM_FRIGUS]寒冰宫殿[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MAELSTROM]大漩涡[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MIRROR_OF_HEAVEN]天堂之镜[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ODIOS_PRISON]欧迪奥之牢[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_POOL_OF_TEARS]泪光之湖[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PYRE_OF_THE_SERAPHIC]邪神火祭场[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_REMNANTS_OF_PATRIA]帕提亚遗迹[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SEVEN_PINES]七松之地[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_TOMB_OF_SUCELLUS]苏塞鲁斯之墓[\\LINK][NEWLINE][LINK=IMPROVEMENT_YGGDRASIL]世界之树[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]Kael 注：加入独特地貌是为了让每张地图更有趣。此外，我们从一开始就在模组中拥有的一些奇观（如世界之树与苏塞鲁斯之墓），作为可建造的奇观其实一直不太合理，还是让它们成为玩家会去发现的东西更好。

english: [H1]Weapon Upgrades[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Some units can have their strength upgraded by certain weapon types. Units capable of using [LINK=PROMOTION_BRONZE_WEAPONS]Bronze weapons[\\LINK] get +1 strength if you have access to [LINK=BONUS_COPPER]copper[\\LINK]. Units capable of using [LINK=PROMOTION_IRON_WEAPONS]Iron weapons[\\LINK] get +2 strength if you have access to [LINK=BONUS_IRON]iron[\\LINK] and units capable of using [LINK=PROMOTION_MITHRIL_WEAPONS]Mithril weapons[\\LINK] get +4 strength if you have access to [LINK=BONUS_MITHRIL]mithril[\\LINK]. Multiple weapon types aren't cumulative (a unit can't have both iron and mithril weapons) and units have to enter one of your cities to upgrade their weapons.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Note that getting access to copper requires the [LINK=TECH_BRONZE_WORKING]Bronze Working[\\LINK] tech (even though it is revealed with Mining). Getting access to Iron requires the [LINK=TECH_IRON_WORKING]Iron Working[\\LINK] tech (though it is revealed with Smelting) and getting access to Mithril requires the [LINK=TECH_MITHRIL_WORKING]Mithril Working[\\LINK] tech.
chinese: [H1]武器升级[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]某些单位可通过特定的武器类型来提升其力量。能够使用[LINK=PROMOTION_BRONZE_WEAPONS]青铜武器[\\LINK]的单位，若你能获取[LINK=BONUS_COPPER]铜[\\LINK]，便 +1 力量。能够使用[LINK=PROMOTION_IRON_WEAPONS]铁制武器[\\LINK]的单位，若你能获取[LINK=BONUS_IRON]铁[\\LINK]，便 +2 力量；能够使用[LINK=PROMOTION_MITHRIL_WEAPONS]秘银武器[\\LINK]的单位，若你能获取[LINK=BONUS_MITHRIL]秘银[\\LINK]，便 +4 力量。多种武器类型不可叠加（一个单位不能同时拥有铁制武器与秘银武器），且单位必须进入你的某座城市方可升级其武器。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]请注意，获取铜需要[LINK=TECH_BRONZE_WORKING]青铜术[\\LINK]科技（尽管它由采矿揭示）。获取铁需要[LINK=TECH_IRON_WORKING]炼铁术[\\LINK]科技（尽管它由精炼揭示），而获取秘银需要[LINK=TECH_MITHRIL_WORKING]秘银采掘[\\LINK]科技。

english: [H1]World Spells[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Each civilization was a World Spell they can use. These spells have a huge effect but can only be used once per game so consider carefully before you use them. The following are the world spells for each civilization:[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Amurites- [LINK=SPELL_ARCANE_LACUNA]Arcane Lacuna[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Balseraphs- [LINK=SPELL_REVELRY]Revelry[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Bannor- [LINK=SPELL_RALLY]Rally[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Calabim- [LINK=SPELL_RIVER_OF_BLOOD]River of Blood[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Clan of Embers- [LINK=SPELL_FOR_THE_HORDE]For the Horde[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Doviello- [LINK=SPELL_WILD_HUNT]Wild Hunt[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Elohim- [LINK=SPELL_SANCTUARY]Sanctuary[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Grigori- [LINK=SPELL_ARDOR]Ardor[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Hippus- [LINK=SPELL_HIPPUS]Hippus[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Illians- [LINK=SPELL_STASIS]Stasis[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Infernal- [LINK=SPELL_HYBOREMS_WHISPER]Hyborem's Whisper[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Khazad- [LINK=SPELL_MOTHER_LODE]Mother Lode[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Kuriotates- [LINK=SPELL_LEGENDS]Legends[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Lanun- [LINK=SPELL_RAGING_SEAS]Raging Seas[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Ljosalfar- [LINK=SPELL_MARCH_OF_THE_TREES]March of the Trees[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Luchuirp- [LINK=SPELL_GIFTS_OF_NANTOSUELTA]Gifts of Nantosuelta[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Malakim- [LINK=SPELL_RELIGIOUS_FERVOR]Religious Fervor[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Mercurians- [LINK=SPELL_DIVINE_RETRIBUTION]Divine Retribution[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Sheaim- [LINK=SPELL_WORLDBREAK]Worldbreak[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Sidar- [LINK=SPELL_INTO_THE_MIST]Into the Mist[\\LINK][NEWLINE]Svartalfar- [LINK=SPELL_VEIL_OF_NIGHT]Veil of Night[\\LINK][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Kael's Notes: We added these for two reasons. Of course they help us differentiate each of the civilizations. But we also wanted to add a strategic option where the player was forced to decide when was the best moment to use the ability. As such all of the World Spells generally grow more powerful over time, rewarding players who don't profit from there use early on.
chinese: [H1]世界法术[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]每个文明都有一个可以使用的世界法术。这些法术效果巨大，但每局游戏只能使用一次，故使用前请慎重考虑。以下是各文明的世界法术：[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]阿姆莱特学院——[LINK=SPELL_ARCANE_LACUNA]魔力空缺[\\LINK][NEWLINE]巴尔塞拉弗族——[LINK=SPELL_REVELRY]狂欢[\\LINK][NEWLINE]班诺尔联邦——[LINK=SPELL_RALLY]集结[\\LINK][NEWLINE]卡拉比姆公国——[LINK=SPELL_RIVER_OF_BLOOD]血之河[\\LINK][NEWLINE]余灰部落——[LINK=SPELL_FOR_THE_HORDE]为了部落[\\LINK][NEWLINE]多维洛部落——[LINK=SPELL_WILD_HUNT]狂野狩猎[\\LINK][NEWLINE]埃洛希姆守护者——[LINK=SPELL_SANCTUARY]庇护所[\\LINK][NEWLINE]格利高里族——[LINK=SPELL_ARDOR]炽热[\\LINK][NEWLINE]希普斯佣兵国——[LINK=SPELL_HIPPUS]希普斯[\\LINK][NEWLINE]伊利安遗族——[LINK=SPELL_STASIS]停滞[\\LINK][NEWLINE]地狱军团——[LINK=SPELL_HYBOREMS_WHISPER]海勃雷姆的低语[\\LINK][NEWLINE]卡扎德王国——[LINK=SPELL_MOTHER_LODE]富矿脉[\\LINK][NEWLINE]库里奥塔特——[LINK=SPELL_LEGENDS]传奇[\\LINK][NEWLINE]拉努恩海盗——[LINK=SPELL_RAGING_SEAS]怒海[\\LINK][NEWLINE]勒约沙尔法——[LINK=SPELL_MARCH_OF_THE_TREES]树木行军[\\LINK][NEWLINE]鲁崔尔普矮人部族——[LINK=SPELL_GIFTS_OF_NANTOSUELTA]南托苏埃尔塔的馈赠[\\LINK][NEWLINE]马拉基姆游牧民——[LINK=SPELL_RELIGIOUS_FERVOR]宗教狂热[\\LINK][NEWLINE]天界军团——[LINK=SPELL_DIVINE_RETRIBUTION]神圣报应[\\LINK][NEWLINE]塞安隐修会——[LINK=SPELL_WORLDBREAK]碎界[\\LINK][NEWLINE]希达永生者——[LINK=SPELL_INTO_THE_MIST]遁入迷雾[\\LINK][NEWLINE]斯瓦塔尔法——[LINK=SPELL_VEIL_OF_NIGHT]夜之帷幕[\\LINK][NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]Kael 注：我们加入这些有两个原因。当然，它们有助于区分各个文明。但我们也想增添一种战略选择，迫使玩家去判断何时是施展该能力的最佳时机。因此，所有世界法术通常都会随时间愈发强大，以回报那些不急于早早从其使用中获利的玩家。

english: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategy: Your vampires (gained at Feudalism) can be fed either through building a couple of big farm cities, or simply by taking over enemy cities and gobbling up their entire population (bon appetit). Spread the gift to as many of your units as you can (your Moroi units can gain vampirism earlier than other unit, which usually requires level six) to allow other unit types access to this easy experience method. With their unique Breeding Pit building, the Calabim also have synergies with the slavery civic; whenever your citizens aren't being used for vampire food, they can be whipped away for production. (Your citizens may feel a bit unhappy, but they'll still be productive with a governor's manor in the city.)
chinese: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]策略：你的吸血鬼（于封建制度获得）可通过两种方式喂养——建造几座大型农业城市，或干脆攻占敌方城市、将其全部人口吞噬殆尽（祝你好胃口）。尽可能把这份天赋传播给更多单位（你的血族战士单位可比其他单位更早获得吸血能力，其他单位通常需要六级），好让别的单位类型也能享用这一轻松的经验来源。凭借其独特的育种坑建筑，卡拉比姆与奴隶劳工政体亦有协同：每当你的市民不被用作吸血鬼的食物时，便可被鞭策抽调去搞生产。（你的市民或许会有些不快，但只要城中有一座总督府邸，他们仍能保持高产。）

english: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategy: The Clan isn't likely to outbuild the other civs. They don't have access to special buildings and suffer a -10% to their tech rate. But this is offset by the fact that they start at peace with the barbarians so they can explore without fear and they usually don't have to worry about protecting their cities in the early game. Although they are able to attack animals, most animals will leave the clan alone, even the fearsome hill giants consider the clan their brothers and usually ignore them. With the masonry technology gained, they can double their unit production with the warrens building, and their "For the Horde!" World Spell has chance of converting any non-hero barbarian orc. A strategy of early and aggressive warfare may thus be for the best.
chinese: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]策略：余灰部落多半在建设上比不过其他文明。他们无法获取特殊建筑，且科技速度承受 -10% 的惩罚。但这被以下事实所抵消：他们开局便与蛮族和平相处，故而可以无所畏惧地探索，早期通常也不必操心保卫城市。尽管他们能够攻击动物，多数动物却会对余灰部落置之不理，就连可怖的山丘巨人也视余灰部落为兄弟，通常无视他们。凭借所获得的石工技术，他们能以兽穴建筑将单位产量翻倍，其“为了部落！”世界法术则有几率转化任何非英雄的蛮族兽人。因此，早期激进作战的策略或许最为可取。

english: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategy: The Doviello don't have the requirements on buildings that other civilizations do. This makes them less reliant on their cities and more able to build units in newly conquered towns. Their battlemaster unit is able to perform upgrades in the field, allowing them to keep their advance going. Charadon starts with the Barbarian trait, and its -10% research rate, while Mahala is better at researching but will find the barbarians to be less hospitable. Also, they begin with the Lucian unit, an axeman equivalent at the time of warriors and scouts. Enjoy an early conquest, you'll need it later.
chinese: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]策略：多维洛部落不像其他文明那样受制于建筑要求。这使他们对城市的依赖更少，更能在新征服的城镇中建造单位。他们的战场支配者单位能在野外进行升级，使其得以保持推进势头。卡拉登开局便带有蛮族特性及其 -10% 研究速度，而玛哈拉更擅长研究，却会发现蛮族对她不那么友善。此外，他们开局便拥有卢西恩单位——在战士与斥候的年代，一个等同于斧兵的存在。尽情享受早期征服吧，往后你会需要它的。

english: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategy: The Khazad are all about money. The more they have per city in their empire the bigger the bonus. Each Khazad city will have a Dwarven Vault building of various levels in it that represents this bonus. Regardless of the strategy used with the Khazad, players would do well to watch their gold amount and make sure their city expansion doesn't drop their vaults to low. They can relax a bit once they achieve Overflowing status, as their bonuses won't go up past that. Runes of Kilmorph is the best religion for making lots of money, and it should also be noted that the Khazad have better siege weapons than the other civilizations although they can't build any spellcaster units beyond adepts.
chinese: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]策略：卡扎德王国的一切都关乎金钱。其帝国内每座城市的金钱越多，加成便越大。每座卡扎德城市都会有一座不同等级的矮人金库建筑来体现这一加成。无论采用何种策略，卡扎德玩家都最好留意自己的金币数量，确保城市扩张不会让金库跌得太低。一旦达到“满溢”状态，他们便可稍稍松口气，因为其加成不会再往上涨。基鲁莫夫之痕是最适合大量敛财的宗教，另需注意的是，卡扎德拥有比其他文明更好的攻城武器，尽管他们无法建造术士以上的任何施法单位。

english: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategy: The Ljosalfar are a defensive civilization-after all, they can't build any siege weapons. Instead, the Light Elves are capable of effectively mounting a war of attrition, using their forested infrastructure to overwhelm the opponent with units and pillage his lands until he's as good as dead. There are alternative methods as well-getting the Baron from the Feral Bond tech and unleashing a horde of Werewolves is an effective way of taking down enemy cities, and mages always exist. With their ability to build things in forests, the Elves have a good synergy with the Fellowship of the Leaves' forest bonuses-but a Fellowship strategy isn't strictly necessary, and following an aggressive religion like the Undertow Overlords will give good early attack units in the form of the Drown.
chinese: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]策略：勒约沙尔法是一个防御型文明——毕竟，他们无法建造任何攻城武器。相反，光明精灵擅长有效地打一场消耗战，利用其森林基建以单位淹没对手、劫掠其土地，直到把他拖到形同灭亡。此外也有别的路子——从野性纽带科技获得狼人男爵、放出一群狼人，是攻陷敌方城市的有效手段，况且法师始终存在。凭借在森林中建造事物的能力，精灵与绿叶之友的森林加成有着良好的协同——但绿叶之友策略并非绝对必要，追随暗涌霸主这样一个激进的宗教，则能以溺死者的形式提供不错的早期攻击单位。

english: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategy: Golems gain no experience, but a combination of the different golem-boosting buildings and Barnaxus will make them pretty mean anyway. Combine this with the fact that they're slightly more powerful than the units they replace, and you'll get a tough army, equally useful for defense and offense. Should you lose Barnaxus, you still have a chance of rebuilding him if you can kill the unit that destroyed him.
chinese: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]策略：魔像无法获得经验，但把各类增强魔像的建筑与巴纳克苏斯组合起来，仍能让它们相当凶悍。再加上它们比所替代的单位略强这一点，你便能得到一支攻守皆宜的强悍军队。倘若你失去了巴纳克苏斯，只要你能杀死摧毁他的那个单位，仍有机会将他重建。

english: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Strategy: Varn Gosam starts with the Creative and Spiritual traits. Quick expansion yields good results, as monuments aren't necessary for Malakim cities to expand. Cottage-spammers will enjoy this Civ, but other strategies are viable as well. Malakim units also start with the nomad promotion, allowing them to ignore the negative effect of deserts. The Malakim's World Spell will help them reach powerful priest units quickly if they spread it well and build temples beforehand.
chinese: [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]策略：范恩·哥萨姆开局带有创造性与精神性两种特性。快速扩张能收获良效，因为马拉基姆的城市无需纪念碑即可扩展边界。热衷铺茅屋的玩家会喜欢这个文明，但别的策略同样可行。马拉基姆单位还开局便带有游牧晋升，使其得以无视沙漠的负面效果。马拉基姆的世界法术若传播得当、并预先建好神庙，将助他们迅速获得强大的祭司单位。

english: If you wish to pass this gate of mine[NEWLINE]You must correctly solve my rhyme[NEWLINE]The Harpy, winged, watches coldly.[NEWLINE]A Satyr, piping, prances boldly.[NEWLINE]A Naga guarding, ever more.[NEWLINE]A Werewolf carved as from the floor.[NEWLINE]The Golem will round out the five.[NEWLINE]Choose the right one to stay alive![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Every monster likes to eat,[NEWLINE]Which finds Humans a tasty treat?[NEWLINE]Each one dwells in just one place,[NEWLINE]A single drink is for each race,[NEWLINE]All have colors, one apiece,[NEWLINE]The key is which on Humans feasts...[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]It's tough to know, without a clue,[NEWLINE]I will give, more than a few,[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]One half a goat, lives in a tree,[NEWLINE]The serpentine, on Half-Elves feeds,[NEWLINE]The hairy one fills up on grog,[NEWLINE]Left of the dungeon are cliffs of fog,[NEWLINE]Cliff dwellers all drink ale, they say,[NEWLINE]He who eats Gnomes is fond of gray,[NEWLINE]Deep in the cave, one favors red,[NEWLINE]In center is the wino's bed,[NEWLINE]The feathered femme lives in the first,[NEWLINE]The friend of brown, for beer will thirst,[NEWLINE]The beast who prefers all things blacker,[NEWLINE]Resides next to the Dwarven snacker,[NEWLINE]Tis beside the one in red,[NEWLINE]Resides an Elven eater's stead,[NEWLINE]Next to the pit, the flyer dwells,[NEWLINE]The construct thinks that green is swell,[NEWLINE]A neighbor of the black of heart,[NEWLINE]Feels drinking water is an art.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]No more clues to help your plight,[NEWLINE]The answer given when it's right.[NEWLINE]Though when it's known, they'll be no doubt.[NEWLINE]So please don't plead, don't beg, don't pout.[NEWLINE]Divine the answer, though it's cruel,[NEWLINE]Who eats Humans as a rule?
chinese: 你若想通过我这道门，[NEWLINE]便须正解我的谜文。[NEWLINE]妖鸟展翅，冷眼旁观。[NEWLINE]萨提尔吹笛，狂舞蹁跹。[NEWLINE]娜迦守护，从不曾眠。[NEWLINE]狼人如刻，仿佛出自地面。[NEWLINE]魔像补足这五者之全。[NEWLINE]择对一者，方可活命于前！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]每头怪物都爱进食，[NEWLINE]谁把人类视作美食？[NEWLINE]各自只栖于一处所，[NEWLINE]每一族各饮一种饮，[NEWLINE]皆有颜色，一者一色，[NEWLINE]关键在于——谁以人类为宴……[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]毫无线索，实难知晓，[NEWLINE]我便给你，不止一二：[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]半羊之身，住在树里，[NEWLINE]蛇形之躯，以半精灵为食，[NEWLINE]多毛那位，痛饮烈酒，[NEWLINE]地牢之左，是雾之绝壁，[NEWLINE]崖居者皆饮麦芽酒，据说如此，[NEWLINE]食侏儒者，钟爱灰色，[NEWLINE]洞穴深处，一者偏爱红色，[NEWLINE]正中央是那醉汉之榻，[NEWLINE]羽饰之女住在第一处，[NEWLINE]棕色之友，为啤酒而渴，[NEWLINE]偏爱一切更黑之物的那头野兽，[NEWLINE]紧挨着那位嗜矮人的食客，[NEWLINE]就在那红色一者之旁，[NEWLINE]住着一位食精灵者，[NEWLINE]紧邻深坑，飞者栖居，[NEWLINE]那构造之物认为绿色最妙，[NEWLINE]黑心者的一位邻居，[NEWLINE]觉得饮水是一门艺术。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]再无线索助你脱困，[NEWLINE]答对之时，答案自明。[NEWLINE]一旦知晓，便无疑问。[NEWLINE]故请莫要恳求、乞怜、噘嘴。[NEWLINE]参透答案，纵然残酷，[NEWLINE]究竟谁以人类为常食？

english: Sometimes landmarks will spawn when the map is created. These are unique improvements that are markers of events from ages past.
